chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Kinānī, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Whoever causes damage by anything in the road of the Muslims, then he is liable for it.”

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims; the public community using the road
key_terms.بِشَيْءٍ: by something; any harmful object or cause
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: legally liable or responsible for compensation

ai.seo_question: Is a person liable for harm caused in a public road in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes liability for harm caused in public pathways used by Muslims. It reflects the legal and moral obligation to protect shared spaces and uphold the rights of others.
